blocks.text: Jandaar (living organism) ke andar radioactive isotope bilkul aam isotope jaisa hi behave karta hai. Lekin radioactive isotope ki jagah aur concentration (miqdar) us ki radiation naap kar aasani se maloom ho jati hai. Is liye radioactive isotope ek nishani (indicator) ya tracer ka kaam karta hai jis se kisi chemical ya biological amal ka rasta dekha ja sakta hai. Tareeqa yeh hai ke kisi maddah mein usi qisam ke stable atoms ki jagah radioactive atoms rakh diye jayen, phir radiation detector se in 'tagged' (nishan lage) atoms ka peecha kiya jaye.

blocks.alt: Maddah ki banawat: molecule (taqreeban 10^-9 m) mein atoms (10^-10 m); atom mein nucleus (10^-15 se 10^-14 m); nucleus mein neutrons aur protons (10^-15 m); neutron ya proton mein quarks (10^-18 m se kam). Mure teer har satah se agli tak jate hain.
blocks.caption: Aap ki maloomat ke liye: maddah ki banawat (kitab ke box ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har qadam pichli cheez ke andar ka hissa hai; sizes paimane (scale) par nahi banaye gaye. Kitab molecule ka size '10° m' chhapti hai; sahi 10^-9 m hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Medical tracer aisa maddah hai jis mein radioactive nuclei hon; ise jism mein dala jata hai, jis tissue ka mutala karna ho woh ise jazb karta hai, aur bahar se detector is ka rasta dekhta hai.
Maslan pani aur khurak mein maujood hydrogen aur sodium jaise chemicals poore jism mein barabar phail jate hain. Kuch doosre chemicals sirf khaas organs mein jazb hote hain.

Bohat se elements ke radioisotopes neutrons aur doosre particles barsa kar aasani se banaye ja sakte hain. Yeh aasani se milte aur saste hain, is liye medicine, zaraat, science ki tehqeeq aur sanat mein in ka istemal bohat barh gaya hai.

Radioisotopes se pata chalta hai ke pecheeda chemical reactions mein kya hota hai aur woh kaise aage barhte hain. Biology mein in se paudon aur janwaron ke chemical reactions ki tehqeeq hui hai. Khaad (fertilizer) mein thoda sa radioactive isotope mila kar radiation detector se aasani se naapa ja sakta hai ke paude ne kitni khaad li. Is se kisan khaad ki sahi miqdar jaan lete hain.

Radiation se paida ki gayi mutations (tabdeeliyon) ke zariye chawal, chane, gandum aur kapas jaisi faslon ki behtar qismen tayyar ki gayi hain. In ki banawat behtar hai, bimariyon aur keedon ke khilaf zyada mazboot hain, aur paidawar aur daane ki quality behtar hai.
Tibbi tashkhees aur ilaj mein istemal
Medicine mein tracers hazme (digestion) ka amal aur jism mein chemical maddon ki harkat samajhne ke liye bohat istemal hote hain.

Maslan radio-iodine zyada tar thyroid gland mein, phosphorus haddiyon mein aur cobalt jigar (liver) mein jazb hota hai, is liye yeh tracers ban sakte hain. Kam activity wale radioisotope ki thodi si miqdar stable isotope ke saath mila kar mareez ko injection ya kisi aur tareeqe se di jati hai, aur radiation detectors se bimar tissue mein us ki jagah maloom ki jati hai. Maslan radioactive iodine se check hota hai ke thyroid gland theek kaam kar raha hai ya nahi; bimar ya zyada active gland normal gland se do guna se zyada iodine jazb karta hai. Radioactive iodine-131 thyroid ke cancer ke ilaj mein bhi istemal hota hai. Isi tarah radioactive sodium-24 se khoon ki gardish (circulation) ka mutala kiya ja sakta hai.
Cancer cells par tajurbon se pata chala hai ke tezi se barhne wale cells zyada radiation jazb karte hain aur ionizing radiation se normal cells ke muqable aasani se khatam ho jate hain.
Imaging devices mein radioactive tracers ne bohat si bimariyon ko samajhne, pehchanne aur ilaj mein madad di hai.

Kuch soorton mein 'seed' naam ke capsules mein radioisotopes malignant (cancer wale) tissue mein laga diye jate hain taake usi jagah kam faasle tak ilaj ho. Jild (skin) ke cancer ke liye phosphorus-32 ya strontium-90 istemal ho sakte hain, lekin dose bohat ehtiyat se control karni parti hai taake sehatmand tissue bache rahen.
Radiation se ilaj karwane wale mareez aksar beemar mehsoos karte hain, kyunke radiation kuch sehatmand tissues ko bhi nuqsan pohanchati hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: 6 ghante wala tibbi isotope technetium-99m (metastable shakal) hai; kitab '99Te' chhapti hai. Te tellurium ka nishan hai, aur sada technetium-99 ki half-life taqreeban 211,000 saal hai, 6 ghante nahi. Is liye table mein Technetium-99m likha gaya hai. Iodine-131 thyroid ke mutale aur ilaj ke liye sab se mashhoor hai, jaisa oopar matan kehta hai.

blocks.prompt: Medicine mein istemal hone wale radioactive tracer ki half-life chhoti kyun honi chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Taake test ke dauran naapne ke liye kafi der active rahe lekin phir jaldi khatam ho jaye, aur mareez ko kam se kam radiation mile.

items: Tracer: radioactive atoms chemically aam atoms jaise, lekin detector se pakde ja sakte hain.
Zaraat: khaad ki jazbiyat, radiation se behtar faslen; medicine: thyroid ke liye iodine-131, khoon ke liye sodium-24.
Radiation se cancer ka ilaj; seeds; dose control zaroori.
